description: Pages of a site that mean nearly the same thing, grouped, which may compete for one search. With a path, the pages nearest that page, each with the two passages that come closest. Read from vectors of the page text, so the site must have been embedded. Passages come under "quoted".

path.description: A page, as a path such as /guides/gravel. Left out, the groups of pages that read alike.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.

name: mttr_similar
title: Find similar pages
